bookInfo.name: Old History of the Five Dynasties
bookInfo.author: Xue Juzheng et al.

title.zh: 卷四十五 唐書21: 閔帝本紀
title.en: Volume 45 Book of Later Tang 21: Emperor Min Annals 1
title.raw: 卷四十五 唐書21: 閔帝本紀 Volume 45 Book of Later Tang 21: Emperor Min Annals 1

sentences.zh: 閔帝，諱從厚，小字菩薩奴，明宗第三子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Min, taboo name Conghou, childhood name Pusainu, was Mingzong's third son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Min, whose taboo name was Conghou and childhood name Pusainu, was the third son of Mingzong.

sentences.zh: 母昭懿皇后夏氏，以天祐十一年歲在甲戌，十一月二十八日庚申，生帝於晉陽舊第。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Zhao-yi née Xia; in the eleventh year of Tianyou, year jiaxu, on the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month, gengshen, the Emperor was born at the old residence in Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Zhao-yi of the Xia clan. In the eleventh year of Tianyou, the jiaxu year, on gengshen, the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month, the future Emperor was born at the old family residence in Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 帝髫齔好讀《春秋》，略通大義，貌類明宗，尤鍾愛。

translations.literal: From childhood the Emperor loved reading the Spring and Autumn Annals, had some grasp of its great meaning, resembled Mingzong in appearance, and was especially cherished.
translations.idiomatic: From boyhood he loved reading the Spring and Autumn Annals and had some grasp of its larger meaning. He looked like Mingzong, who cherished him above the rest.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月二十日，秦王誅。

translations.literal: On the twentieth day of the eleventh month of the fourth year, the Prince of Qin was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the twentieth day of the eleventh month of the fourth year, the Prince of Qin was put to death.

sentences.zh: 翌日，明宗遣宣徽使孟漢瓊馳驛召帝，二十六日，明宗崩，二十九日，帝至自鄴。

translations.literal: The next day Mingzong dispatched Palace Attendant envoy Meng Hanqiong by express relay to summon the Emperor; on the twenty-sixth Mingzong died; on the twenty-ninth the Emperor arrived from Ye.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Mingzong sent Meng Hanqiong, Palace Attendant envoy, by express relay to summon him. On the twenty-sixth Mingzong died; on the twenty-ninth the Emperor arrived from Ye.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，發喪於西宮，帝於柩前即位。

translations.literal: Twelfth month guimao new moon: mourning was proclaimed at the Western Palace; the Emperor assumed the throne before the bier.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao new moon of the twelfth month mourning was proclaimed at the Western Palace, and the Emperor took the throne before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 丁未，群臣上表請聽政，表再上，詔允。

translations.literal: On dingwei the ministers memorialized requesting that he assume governance; the memorial was submitted again, and an edict granted it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the ministers memorialized asking him to take up governance. When the memorial was submitted a second time, an edict granted the request.

sentences.zh: 己酉，中外將士給賜有差。

translations.literal: On jiyou inner and outer military officers received differentiated stipends and gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou soldiers and officers inside and outside the capital received stipends and gifts according to rank.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，帝縗服見群臣於廣壽門之東廡下，宰臣馮道進曰：「陛下久居哀毀，臣等鹹願一睹聖顏。

translations.literal: On gengxu the Emperor in hemp mourning garments met the ministers under the eastern portico of the Gate of Broad Longevity; chief minister Feng Dao advanced and said: "Your Majesty has long remained in grief and self-abnegation; we all wish to behold your sacred countenance.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Emperor, still in hemp mourning, met the ministers under the eastern portico of the Gate of Broad Longevity. Chief minister Feng Dao stepped forward and said, "Your Majesty has long kept to grief and fasting; we all long to see your face again."

sentences.zh: 」朱宏昭前舉帽，群臣再拜而退。

translations.literal: " Zhu Hongzhao stepped forward and raised his cap; the ministers bowed twice and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hongzhao stepped forward and lifted his cap; the ministers bowed twice and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 禦光政樓存問軍民。

translations.literal: He took the Hall of Radiant Governance to inquire after soldiers and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: He went to the Hall of Radiant Governance to inquire after soldiers and civilians.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賜司衣王氏死，坐秦王事也。

translations.literal: On xinhai Lady Wang of the Wardrobe Service was granted death, on account of the Prince of Qin affair.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Lady Wang of the Wardrobe Service was sentenced to death for her part in the Prince of Qin affair.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以前鎮州節度使、涇王從敏權知河南府事，尋以盧質代之。

translations.literal: On guichou former Zhenzhou military commissioner, Prince of Jing Congmin was appointed acting Mayor of Henan; soon Lu Zhi replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Congmin, Prince of Jing and former commissioner of Zhenzhou, was made acting mayor of Henan; Lu Zhi soon replaced him.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜司儀康氏死，事連王氏也。

translations.literal: On yimao Lady Kang of the Ceremonial Service was granted death; the matter was linked to Lady Wang.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Lady Kang of the Ceremonial Service was sentenced to death in connection with Lady Wang's case.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以天雄軍節度判官唐汭為諫議大夫，掌書記趙彖為起居郎，元從都押衙宋令詢為磁州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingchen Tianxiong Army adjutant Tang Rui was made Remonstrance Counsellor; chief secretary Zhao Tong was made Remending Officer; original follower chief military aide Song Lingxun was made Cizhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Tang Rui, adjutant of the Tianxiong Army, was made Remonstrance Counsellor; Zhao Tong, chief secretary, became Remending Officer; and Song Lingxun, chief military aide from the Emperor's original entourage, was made prefect of Cizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以左僕射、平章事馮道為山陵使，戶部尚書韓彥惲為副，中書舍人王延為判官，禮部尚書王權為禮儀使，兵部尚書李鈴為鹵簿使，御史中丞龍敏為儀仗使，右僕射、權知河南府盧質為橋道頓遞使。

translations.literal: On dingsi Left Vice Director and Grand Counsellor Feng Dao was made imperial tomb commissioner; Minister of Revenue Han Yanyun was made deputy; Secretariat drafter Wang Yan was made administrative officer; Minister of Rites Wang Quan was made rites commissioner; Minister of War Li Ling was made guard-of-honor commissioner; Vice Censor-in-Chief Long Min was made ceremony commissioner; Right Vice Director and acting Mayor of Henan Lu Zhi was made bridge-route relay commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Feng Dao, Left Vice Director and Grand Counsellor, was made imperial tomb commissioner, with Han Yanyun, Minister of Revenue, as deputy. Wang Yan, Secretariat drafter, was made administrative officer; Wang Quan, Minister of Rites, rites commissioner; Li Ling, Minister of War, guard-of-honor commissioner; Long Min, Vice Censor-in-Chief, ceremony commissioner; and Lu Zhi, Right Vice Director and acting mayor of Henan, bridge-route relay commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以前相州刺史郝瓊為右驍衛大將軍，充宣徽北院使；

translations.literal: On gengshen former Xiangzhou prefect Hao Qiong was made General of the Right Martial Guard and appointed Palace Attendant of the Northern Bureau;
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Hao Qiong, former prefect of Xiangzhou, was made General of the Right Martial Guard and appointed Palace Attendant of the Northern Bureau;

sentences.zh: 以光祿卿、充三司副使王玫為三司使。

translations.literal: Court Provisioner and acting Deputy Commissioner of the Three Offices Wang Mei was made Commissioner of the Three Offices.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mei, Court Provisioner and acting deputy commissioner of the Three Offices, was made commissioner of the Three Offices.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，故檢校太尉、右衛上將軍、充三司使孫嶽贈太尉、齊國公。

translations.literal: On guihai the late honorary Grand Commandant, General of the Right Guard, and Commissioner of the Three Offices Sun Yue was posthumously advanced to Grand Commandant and Duke of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Sun Yue, late honorary Grand Commandant, General of the Right Guard, and commissioner of the Three Offices, was posthumously made Grand Commandant and Duke of Qi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，帝釋縗服，群臣三上表，請復常膳，禦正殿，從之。

translations.literal: On dingmao the Emperor removed his hemp mourning garments; the ministers thrice memorialized requesting resumption of normal meals and attendance at the main hall; he assented.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Emperor put off his mourning garb. The ministers memorialized three times asking him to resume normal meals and hold court in the main hall, and he agreed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，帝御中興殿，群臣列位，馮道升階進酒。

translations.literal: On xinwei the Emperor took the Hall of Central Revival; the ministers took their places; Feng Dao ascended the steps and presented wine.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Emperor held court in the Hall of Central Revival with the ministers in their places. Feng Dao mounted the steps and offered wine.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「比於此物無愛，除賓友之會，不近樽斝。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "As for this thing I have no fondness; except at gatherings with guests and friends, I do not approach the wine cup.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "I have never cared for this. Except when meeting guests and friends, I do not go near the cup.

sentences.zh: 況在沉痛之中，安事飲啖！

translations.literal: How much more in the midst of deep grief—what business is there in eating and drinking!
translations.idiomatic: And now, in the depths of grief, what place is there for food and drink?

sentences.zh: 」命徹之。

translations.literal: " He ordered it removed.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered it taken away.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，宰臣馮道加司空，李愚加右僕射，劉煦加吏部尚書，餘並如故。

translations.literal: On gengchen chief minister Feng Dao was advanced to Minister of Works; Li Yu was advanced to Right Vice Director; Liu Xu was advanced to Minister of Personnel; the rest remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen chief minister Feng Dao was made Minister of Works; Li Yu became Right Vice Director; Liu Xu, Minister of Personnel; the rest kept their former posts.

sentences.zh: 壬午，侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、河陽節度使康義誠加檢校太尉、兼侍中，判六軍諸衛事。

translations.literal: On renwu Commander of the Imperial Guard horse and foot, Heyang military commissioner Kang Yicheng was advanced honorary Grand Commandant and concurrent Palace Attendant, and was empowered over the Six Armies and various guards.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Kang Yicheng, commander of the imperial guard horse and foot and commissioner of Heyang, was made honorary Grand Commandant and concurrent Palace Attendant and given charge of the Six Armies and palace guards.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以侍衛馬軍都指揮使、寧國軍節度使安彥威為河中節度使；

translations.literal: On jiashen Commander of the Imperial Guard cavalry, Ningguo Army military commissioner An Yanwei was made Hezhong military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen An Yanwei, commander of the imperial cavalry and commissioner of the Ningguo Army, was made commissioner of Hezhong;

sentences.zh: 以侍衛步軍都指揮使、忠正軍節度使張從賓為涇州節度使，並加檢校太傅；

translations.literal: Commander of the Imperial Guard infantry, Zhongzheng Army military commissioner Zhang Congbin was made Jingzhou military commissioner, both advanced honorary Grand Mentor;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Congbin, commander of the imperial infantry and commissioner of the Zhongzheng Army, was made commissioner of Jingzhou; both were advanced honorary Grand Mentor;

sentences.zh: 以捧聖左右廂都指揮使、欽州刺史朱洪實為寧國軍節度使，加檢校太保，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: Commander of the left and right wings of the Sacred Guard, Qinzhou prefect Zhu Hongshi was made Ningguo Army military commissioner, advanced honorary Grand Guardian, and appointed Commander of the Imperial Guard cavalry;
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hongshi, commander of the left and right wings of the Sacred Guard and prefect of Qinzhou, was made commissioner of the Ningguo Army, advanced honorary Grand Guardian, and appointed commander of the imperial cavalry;

sentences.zh: 以嚴衛左右廂都指揮使、岩州刺史皇甫遇為忠正軍節度使、檢校太保，充侍衛步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Commander of the left and right wings of the Strict Guard, Yanzhou prefect Huangfu Yu was made Zhongzheng Army military commissioner and honorary Grand Guardian, and appointed Commander of the Imperial Guard infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Yu, commander of the left and right wings of the Strict Guard and prefect of Yanzhou, was made commissioner of the Zhongzheng Army and honorary Grand Guardian, and appointed commander of the imperial infantry.

sentences.zh: 戊子，樞密使、檢校太尉、同平章事朱宏昭，樞密使、檢校太尉、同中書門下二品馮贇並加兼中書令。

translations.literal: On wuzi Military Affairs Commissioners, honorary Grand Commandant, co-equal Grand Counsellor Zhu Hongzhao and Military Affairs Commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, Second Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery Feng Yun were both advanced concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zhu Hongzhao, Military Affairs Commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and co-equal Grand Counsellor, and Feng Yun, Military Affairs Commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and Second Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery, were both made concurrent Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 北京留守、河東節度使兼大同彰國振武威塞等軍蕃漢馬步總管石敬瑭加兼中書令；

translations.literal: Beijing regent, Hedong military commissioner, and overall commander of Han and non-Han horse and foot of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies Shi Jingtang was advanced concurrent Director of the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Shi Jingtang, Beijing regent, Hedong commissioner, and overall commander of Han and non-Han forces of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies, was made concurrent Director of the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令趙德鈞加檢校太師、兼中書令。

translations.literal: Youzhou military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Zhao Dejun was advanced honorary Grand Preceptor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Dejun, commissioner of Youzhou, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, was advanced honorary Grand Preceptor while retaining the directorship.

sentences.zh: 樞密使馮贇表堅讓中書令，製改兼侍中，封邠國公。

translations.literal: Military Affairs Commissioner Feng Yun memorialized firmly declining the Directorship of the Secretariat; an edict changed it to concurrent Palace Attendant and enfeoffed him Duke of Bin.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yun, Military Affairs Commissioner, firmly declined the directorship in a memorial. An edict changed the appointment to concurrent Palace Attendant and enfeoffed him as Duke of Bin.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，鳳翔節度使、潞王從珂加兼侍中；

translations.literal: On gengyin Fengxiang military commissioner, Prince of Lu Congke was advanced concurrent Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Congke, Prince of Lu and commissioner of Fengxiang, was made concurrent Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 青州節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令房知溫加檢校太師。

translations.literal: Qingzhou military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Fang Zhiwen was advanced honorary Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Zhiwen, commissioner of Qingzhou, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, was advanced honorary Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以翰林學士承旨、尚書右丞李懌為工部尚書，以秘書監盧文紀為太常卿，充山陵禮儀使。

translations.literal: On xinmao Hanlin Academician Exemplar and Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Li Yi was made Minister of Works; Director of the Palace Library Lu Wenji was made Grand Minister of Rites and appointed imperial tomb rites commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Yi, Hanlin Academician Exemplar and Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Minister of Works; Lu Wenji, Director of the Palace Library, was made Grand Minister of Rites and appointed imperial tomb rites commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，荊南節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令高從誨封南平王；

translations.literal: On renchen Jingnan military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Gao Conghui was enfeoffed Prince of Nanping;
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Gao Conghui, commissioner of Jingnan, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, was enfeoffed Prince of Nanping;

sentences.zh: 湖南節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令馬希範封楚王。

translations.literal: Hunan military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Ma Xifan was enfeoffed Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xifan, commissioner of Hunan, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, was enfeoffed Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 甲午，兩浙節度使、檢校太師、守中書令、吳王錢元瓘進封吳越王；

translations.literal: On jiawu Liang-Zhe military commissioner, honorary Grand Preceptor, Acting Director of the Secretariat, Prince of Wu Qian Yuanguan was advanced and enfeoffed King of Wuyue;
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Qian Yuanguan, commissioner of Liang-Zhe, honorary Grand Preceptor, Acting Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Wu, was advanced and enfeoffed King of Wuyue;

sentences.zh: 前洺州團練使皇甫立加檢校太保，充鄜州節度使；

translations.literal: Former Mingzhou training commissioner Huangfu Li was advanced honorary Grand Guardian and appointed Yanzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Li, former training commissioner of Mingzhou, was advanced honorary Grand Guardian and made commissioner of Yanzhou;

sentences.zh: 前彰義軍節度使康福加檢校太傅，充邠州節度使；

translations.literal: Former Zhangyi Army military commissioner Kang Fu was advanced honorary Grand Mentor and appointed Binzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Kang Fu, former commissioner of the Zhangyi Army, was advanced honorary Grand Mentor and made commissioner of Binzhou;

sentences.zh: 劍南東、西兩川節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令、蜀王孟知祥加檢校太師。

translations.literal: Military commissioner of the Eastern and Western Circuits of Jiannan, honorary Grand Commandant, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Shu Meng Zhixiang was advanced honorary Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Zhixiang, commissioner of the Eastern and Western Circuits of Jiannan, honorary Grand Commandant, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Shu, was advanced honorary Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 製下，知祥辭不受命。

translations.literal: When the edict was issued, Zhixiang declined and did not accept the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: When the edict was issued, Zhixiang declined the appointment.

sentences.zh: 丙申，鎮州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中範延光，汴州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中趙延壽，並加檢校太師。

translations.literal: On bingshen Zhenzhou military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Palace Attendant Fan Yanguang and Bianzhou military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Palace Attendant Zhao Yanshou were both advanced honorary Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Fan Yanguang, commissioner of Zhenzhou, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Palace Attendant, and Zhao Yanshou, commissioner of Bianzhou, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Palace Attendant, were both advanced honorary Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，山南西道節度使、檢校太傅、同平章事張虔釗，襄州節度使趙在禮，並加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On wuxu Shannan West Circuit military commissioner, honorary Grand Mentor, and co-equal Grand Counsellor Zhang Qianzhao and Xiangzhou military commissioner Zhao Zaili were both advanced honorary Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Zhang Qianzhao, commissioner of the Shannan West Circuit, honorary Grand Mentor, and co-equal Grand Counsellor, and Zhao Zaili, commissioner of Xiangzhou, were both advanced honorary Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以振武軍節度使、安北都護楊檀兼大同、彰國、振武、威塞等軍都虞候，充北面馬軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On xinchou Zhenwu Army military commissioner and Protector-General of Pacifying the North Yang Tan was made concurrent Chief Commandant of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies, and appointed Northern Front cavalry commander.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Yang Tan, commissioner of the Zhenwu Army and Protector-General of Pacifying the North, was made concurrent chief commandant of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies and appointed commander of northern-front cavalry.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬寅朔，群臣赴西宮臨。

translations.literal: Intercalary month renyin new moon: the ministers went to the Western Palace to attend the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the intercalary month the ministers went to the Western Palace to attend the coffin.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，禦文明殿入閣。

translations.literal: On guimao he took the Hall of Civil Brilliance and entered the pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he held court in the Hall of Civil Brilliance and entered the pavilion.

sentences.zh: 以前右僕射、權知河南府事盧質為太子少傅兼河南尹。

translations.literal: Former Right Vice Director and acting Mayor of Henan Lu Zhi was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and concurrent Mayor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhi, former Right Vice Director and acting mayor of Henan, was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and concurrent mayor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 以諫議大夫唐汭、膳部郎中知制誥陳乂並為給事中，充樞密院直學士。

translations.literal: Remonstrance Counsellor Tang Rui and Board of Rites bureau director and drafter of edicts Chen Yi were both made Supervising Secretaries and appointed direct academicians of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Rui, Remonstrance Counsellor, and Chen Yi, bureau director of the Board of Rites and drafter of edicts, were both made Supervising Secretaries and appointed direct academicians of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note:

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》：汭以文學從帝，曆三鎮在幕府。

translations.literal: (The Comprehensive Mirror: Rui followed the Emperor for his literary talent and served in three circuits' staff offices.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Comprehensive Mirror: Rui had followed the Emperor for his literary talent and served on the staffs of three circuits.

sentences.zh: 及即位，將佐之有才者，朱、馮皆斥逐之。

translations.literal: When he acceded to the throne, among the capable commanders and aides Zhu and Feng all were dismissed and driven away.
translations.idiomatic: When he took the throne, Zhu and Feng drove away every capable commander and aide.

sentences.zh: 汭性迂疏，朱、馮恐帝含怒有時而發，乃引汭於密近，以其黨陳乂監之。）〉

translations.literal: Rui's nature was pedantic and unworldly; Zhu and Feng feared the Emperor's stored anger might break out in time, so they brought Rui into close attendance and had their partisan Chen Yi supervise him.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Rui was pedantic and unworldly by nature. Zhu and Feng feared the Emperor's buried anger might someday erupt, so they brought Rui close and set their ally Chen Yi to watch him.)〉

sentences.zh: 宣徽南院使、驃騎大將軍、左衛上將軍、知內侍省孟漢瓊加開府儀同三司，賜忠貞扶運保泰功臣。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant of the Southern Bureau, General of Agile Cavalry, General of the Left Guard, and Director of the Palace Domestic Service Meng Hanqiong was advanced Grand Preceptor with the Opening of a Prefecture and Three Departments of Equal Standing, and was granted the title Merit Minister of Loyal Integrity, Upholding the Dynasty, and Preserving Tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Hanqiong, Palace Attendant of the Southern Bureau, General of Agile Cavalry, General of the Left Guard, and director of the Palace Domestic Service, was advanced Grand Preceptor with the Opening of a Prefecture and Three Departments of Equal Standing and granted the merit title Loyal Integrity, Upholding the Dynasty, and Preserving Tranquility.

sentences.zh: 丙午，正衙命使冊皇太后曹氏。

translations.literal: On bingwu at formal court envoys were commissioned to invest Empress Dowager née Cao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu court envoys were commissioned at formal audience to invest Empress Dowager of the Cao clan.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以前雄武軍節度使劉仲殷為右衛上將軍，邢州節度使趙鳳加爵邑。

translations.literal: On wushen former Xiongwu Army military commissioner Liu Zhongyin was made General of the Right Guard; Xingzhou military commissioner Zhao Feng was advanced in noble rank and fief.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Liu Zhongyin, former commissioner of the Xiongwu Army, was made General of the Right Guard; Zhao Feng, commissioner of Xingzhou, received additional noble rank and fief.

sentences.zh: 自是諸藩鎮文武臣僚皆次第加恩，帝嗣位覃恩澤也。

translations.literal: From this time the civil and military officers of the various military prefectures all received grace in turn—it was the broad grace of the Emperor's succession.
translations.idiomatic: From then on civil and military officers of the frontier commands received honors in turn, part of the broad grace granted on the Emperor's accession.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、中書舍人崔棁為工部侍郎，依前充職。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician and Secretariat drafter Cui Wan was made Vice Minister of Works, continuing in his former duties.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Wan, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat drafter, was made Vice Minister of Works while continuing his former duties.

sentences.zh: 以給事中張鵬為御史中丞，以御史中丞龍敏為兵部侍郎，以太僕少卿竇維為大理卿。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Zhang Peng was made Vice Censor-in-Chief; Vice Censor-in-Chief Long Min was made Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud Dou Wei was made Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Peng, Supervising Secretary, was made Vice Censor-in-Chief; Long Min, Vice Censor-in-Chief, Vice Minister of War; and Dou Wei, Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, Director of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，正衙命使冊皇太妃王氏。

translations.literal: On jiayin at formal court envoys were commissioned to invest Imperial Consort née Wang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin court envoys were commissioned at formal audience to invest Imperial Consort Wang.

sentences.zh: 集賢院上言：「準敕書修創淩煙閣，尋奉詔問閣高下等級。

translations.literal: The Academy of Scholarly Worthies memorialized: "In accordance with the edict to repair and rebuild the Lingyan Pavilion, we then received an imperial order inquiring about the pavilion's height, levels, and ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The Academy of Scholarly Worthies reported, "By edict we are to repair and rebuild the Lingyan Pavilion, and we have now received an imperial order asking about the pavilion's height, levels, and ranks.

sentences.zh: 謹按淩煙閣，都長安時在西內三清殿側，畫像皆北面，閣有中隔，隔內面北寫功高宰輔，南面寫功高諸侯王，隔外面次第圖畫功臣題讚。

translations.literal: We respectfully note that the Lingyan Pavilion, when in Chang'an, stood beside the Three Pure Hall in the inner western palace; all portraits faced north. The pavilion had a central partition: within the partition, on the north side were painted chief ministers of highest merit, and on the south side princes and kings of highest merit; outside the partition, meritorious ministers were painted in sequence with inscribed eulogies.
translations.idiomatic: We find that when the Lingyan Pavilion stood in Chang'an it was beside the Three Pure Hall in the inner western palace, with all portraits facing north. The pavilion had a central partition: within it, on the north side, were painted the highest-ranking chief ministers, and on the south the highest-ranking princes and kings; outside the partition meritorious ministers were painted in order with inscribed eulogies.

sentences.zh: 自西京板蕩，四十餘年，舊日主掌官吏及畫像工人，並已淪喪，集賢院所管寫真官、畫真官人數不少，都洛後廢職。

translations.literal: Since the Western Capital was ravaged, more than forty years have passed; the former supervising officials and portrait painters have all perished. The portrait-copying and portrait-painting officers under the Academy of Scholarly Worthies were not few in number, but after the move to Luoyang the posts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Western Capital was ravaged more than forty years ago, the former supervising officials and portrait painters have all been lost. The Academy once maintained many portrait-copying and portrait-painting officers, but those posts were abolished after the move to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 今將起閣，望先定佐命功臣人數，請下翰林院預令寫真本，及下將作監興功，次序間架修建。

translations.literal: Now that the pavilion is to be raised, we hope first to fix the number of founding merit ministers; we request that the Hanlin Academy be ordered in advance to prepare portrait models, and that the Directorate of Palace Buildings be ordered to begin construction and build in proper sequence and frame.
translations.idiomatic: As the pavilion is now to be rebuilt, we ask first to fix the number of founding merit ministers, and request orders to the Hanlin Academy to prepare portrait models in advance and to the Directorate of Palace Buildings to begin construction in proper sequence and frame.

sentences.zh: 」乃詔集賢御書院復置寫真官、畫真官各一員，餘依所奏。

translations.literal: " An edict then restored one portrait-copying officer and one portrait-painting officer each at the Academy of Scholarly Worthies and Imperial Calligraphy Academy; the rest followed the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then restored one portrait-copying officer and one portrait-painting officer at the Academy of Scholarly Worthies and Imperial Calligraphy Academy; the rest followed the memorial.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，安州奏，此月七日夜，節度使符彥超為部曲王希全所害，廢朝一日。

translations.literal: On dingsi Anzhou reported that on the seventh night of this month military commissioner Fu Yanchao was killed by his troops under Wang Xiquan; court was suspended for one day.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Anzhou reported that on the seventh night of that month Commissioner Fu Yanchao was killed by his troops under Wang Xiquan; court was suspended for one day.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以前振武軍節度使、安北都護高行周為彰武節度使。

translations.literal: On wuwu former Zhenwu Army military commissioner and Protector-General of Pacifying the North Gao Xingzhou was made Zhangwu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Gao Xingzhou, former commissioner of the Zhenwu Army and Protector-General of Pacifying the North, was made commissioner of Zhangwu.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前鄆州使範政為少府監。

translations.literal: On xinyou former Yanzhou envoy Fan Zheng was made Director of the Palace Workshops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Fan Zheng, former envoy of Yanzhou, was made Director of the Palace Workshops.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幸至德宮。

translations.literal: On bingyin he visited the Palace of Utmost Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he visited the Palace of Utmost Virtue.

sentences.zh: 車駕至興教門，有飛鳶自空而墜，僵於御前。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage reached the Gate of Promoting Instruction, a flying kite fell from the sky and lay stiff before the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage reached the Gate of Promoting Instruction, a kite fell from the sky and dropped dead before the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 是日大風晦冥。

translations.literal: That day great wind and murky darkness.
translations.idiomatic: That day fierce winds blew and the sky turned dark.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，以前鎮州節度使、涇王從敏為宋州節度使。

translations.literal: Second month yihai: former Zhenzhou military commissioner, Prince of Jing Congmin was made Songzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the second month Congmin, Prince of Jing and former commissioner of Zhenzhou, was made commissioner of Songzhou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以前徐州節度使、檢校太傅李敬周為安州節度使。

translations.literal: On jimao former Xuzhou military commissioner, honorary Grand Mentor Li Jingzhou was made Anzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Li Jingzhou, former commissioner of Xuzhou and honorary Grand Mentor, was made commissioner of Anzhou.

sentences.zh: 是日，宣授鳳翔節度使、潞王從珂為權北京留守；

translations.literal: That day by proclamation Fengxiang military commissioner, Prince of Lu Congke was appointed acting Beijing regent;
translations.idiomatic: That same day Congke, Prince of Lu and commissioner of Fengxiang, was proclaimed acting Beijing regent;

sentences.zh: 以北京留守石敬瑭權知鎮州軍州事；

translations.literal: Beijing regent Shi Jingtang was appointed acting administrator of Zhenzhou military and civil affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Shi Jingtang, Beijing regent, was made acting administrator of Zhenzhou;

sentences.zh: 以鎮州範延光權知鄴都留守事；

translations.literal: Zhenzhou Fan Yanguang was appointed acting regent of Yedu;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang of Zhenzhou was made acting regent of Yedu;

sentences.zh: 以前河中節度使、洋王從璋權知鳳翔軍軍府事。

translations.literal: Former Hezhong military commissioner, Prince of Yang Congzhang was appointed acting administrator of Fengxiang Army headquarters affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Congzhang, Prince of Yang and former commissioner of Hezhong, was made acting administrator of Fengxiang headquarters.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，幸山陵工作所。

translations.literal: On gengyin he visited the imperial tomb construction site.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he visited the imperial tomb construction site.

sentences.zh: 是日，西京留守王思同奏，鳳翔節度使、潞王從珂拒命。

translations.literal: That day Western Capital regent Wang Sitong memorialized that Fengxiang military commissioner, Prince of Lu Congke had refused orders.
translations.idiomatic: That day Wang Sitong, regent of the Western Capital, reported that Congke, Prince of Lu and commissioner of Fengxiang, had refused orders.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，王思同加同平章事，充西面行營都部署；

translations.literal: On dingyou Wang Sitong was advanced co-equal Grand Counsellor and appointed supreme commander of the western campaign headquarters;
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Wang Sitong was made co-equal Grand Counsellor and appointed supreme commander of the western campaign;

sentences.zh: 以前邠州節度使藥彥稠為副部署。

translations.literal: Former Binzhou military commissioner Yao Yanchou was made deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yanchou, former commissioner of Binzhou, was made deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 以河中節度使安彥威為西面兵馬都監，以前定州節度使李德充為權北京留守。

translations.literal: Hezhong military commissioner An Yanwei was made western campaign inspector of armies and horses; former Dingzhou military commissioner Li Dechong was appointed acting Beijing regent.
translations.idiomatic: An Yanwei, commissioner of Hezhong, was made inspector of armies and horses for the western campaign; Li Dechong, former commissioner of Dingzhou, was made acting Beijing regent.

sentences.zh: 山陵使奏：「伏睹御劄，皇帝親奉靈駕至園陵。

translations.literal: The imperial tomb commissioner memorialized: "We have respectfully seen the imperial note that the Emperor will personally escort the spirit carriage to the imperial park tomb.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial tomb commissioner reported, "We have seen the imperial note that Your Majesty will personally escort the spirit carriage to the imperial park tomb.

sentences.zh: 伏見累朝故事，人君無親送葬之儀，請車駕不行。

translations.literal: We have seen the precedents of successive dynasties: sovereigns have no rite of personally escorting the burial; we request that the imperial carriage not go.
translations.idiomatic: By the precedents of successive dynasties, no sovereign has ever personally escorted a burial. We ask that the imperial carriage not go.

sentences.zh: 」不從。

translations.literal: " He did not assent.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor did not agree.

sentences.zh: 乙未，樞密使馮贇起復視事，時贇丁母憂也。

translations.literal: On yiwei Military Affairs Commissioner Feng Yun was recalled from mourning to resume office; at the time Yun was in mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Feng Yun, Military Affairs Commissioner, was recalled from mourning to resume office; he was then in mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以司農卿張鎛為殿中監。

translations.literal: On jihai Director of the Court of the Imperial Granaries Zhang Bo was made Director of the Palace Domestic Service.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Zhang Bo, Director of the Court of the Imperial Granaries, was made Director of the Palace Domestic Service.

sentences.zh: 庚子，殿直楚匡祚上言，監取亳州團練使李重吉至宋州，係於軍院。

translations.literal: On gengzi Palace Guard Chu Kuangzuo memorialized that he had escorted Bozhou training commissioner Li Chongji to Songzhou and detained him in the military compound.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Chu Kuangzuo, Palace Guard, reported that he had escorted Li Chongji, training commissioner of Bozhou, to Songzhou and detained him in the military compound.

sentences.zh: 重吉，潞王之長子，及幽於宋州，帝猶以金帛賜之，及聞西師鹹叛，方遣使殺之。

translations.literal: Chongji was the Prince of Lu's eldest son; though imprisoned at Songzhou, the Emperor still sent him gold and silk; only upon hearing that the western army had all rebelled did he dispatch envoys to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Chongji was the Prince of Lu's eldest son. Though he was imprisoned at Songzhou, the Emperor still sent him gold and silk; only when he heard that the entire western army had rebelled did he dispatch envoys to kill him.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，以前太僕少卿魏仁鍔為太僕卿。

translations.literal: Third month jiachen: former Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud Wei Rene was made Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the third month Wei Rene, former Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, was made its minister.

sentences.zh: 興元節度使張虔釗奏，會合討鳳翔。

translations.literal: Xingyuan military commissioner Zhang Qianzhao memorialized that he would join forces to attack Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qianzhao, commissioner of Xingyuan, reported that he would join the campaign against Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以右領衛上將軍武延翰為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingwu General of the Right Leading Guard Wu Yanhan was made Yingzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Wu Yanhan, General of the Right Leading Guard, was made prefect of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，洋州孫漢韶奏，至興元與張虔釗同議進軍。

translations.literal: On dingwei Yangzhou Sun Hanshao memorialized that he had reached Xingyuan and jointly deliberated advancing the army with Zhang Qianzhao.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Sun Hanshao of Yangzhou reported that he had reached Xingyuan and agreed with Zhang Qianzhao on advancing the army.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以鎮州節度使範延光依前檢校太師、兼侍中，行興唐尹，充天雄軍節度使、北面水陸轉運製置使；

translations.literal: On jiyou Zhenzhou military commissioner Fan Yanguang, as before honorary Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Attendant, was made acting Mayor of Xingtang and appointed Tianxiong Army military commissioner and northern-front water-and-land transport commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Fan Yanguang, commissioner of Zhenzhou, retained his honorary Grand Preceptor rank and concurrent Palace Attendant post, was made acting mayor of Xingtang, and appointed commissioner of the Tianxiong Army and northern-front water-and-land transport commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以北京留守、河東節度使石敬瑭依前檢校太尉、兼中書令，其真定尹、充鎮州節度使、大同彰國振武威塞等軍蕃漢馬步總管如故。

translations.literal: Beijing regent and Hedong military commissioner Shi Jingtang, as before honorary Grand Commandant and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, retained his posts as Mayor of Zhending, Zhenzhou military commissioner, and overall commander of Han and non-Han horse and foot of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Jingtang, Beijing regent and Hedong commissioner, retained his honorary Grand Commandant rank and concurrent Directorship, and kept his posts as mayor of Zhending, commissioner of Zhenzhou, and overall commander of Han and non-Han forces of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以前定州節度使李德充為北京留守，充河東節度使。

translations.literal: On xinhai former Dingzhou military commissioner Li Dechong was made Beijing regent and appointed Hedong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Li Dechong, former commissioner of Dingzhou, was made Beijing regent and commissioner of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 許王從益加檢校太保，前河中節度使、洋王從璋加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: Prince of Xu Congyi was advanced honorary Grand Guardian; former Hezhong military commissioner, Prince of Yang Congzhang was advanced honorary Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Congyi, Prince of Xu, was advanced honorary Grand Guardian; Congzhang, Prince of Yang and former commissioner of Hezhong, was advanced honorary Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 詔：「藩侯帶平章事以上薨，許立神道碑，差官撰文。

translations.literal: Edict: "When a frontier lord bearing Grand Counsellor rank or above dies, he may be granted a spirit-way stele; officials shall be dispatched to compose the text.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared, "When a frontier lord of Grand Counsellor rank or above dies, he may be granted a spirit-way stele, and officials shall be dispatched to compose the inscription.

sentences.zh: 未帶平章事及刺史，準令式合立碑者，其文任自製撰，不在奏聞。

translations.literal: Those not bearing Grand Counsellor rank and [those who are] prefects, where regulations permit erecting steles, may compose the text themselves and need not memorialize it to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: For those who did not hold Grand Counsellor rank or who served as prefects, but who were eligible under regulations to erect steles, the text could be composed at their own discretion without submitting it for imperial review.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，興元張虔釗奏，自鎮將兵赴鳳翔，收大散關。

translations.literal: " On yimao Zhang Qianzhao of Xingyuan memorialized that he would lead troops from his post to Fengxiang and recover Dasan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Zhang Qianzhao of Xingyuan reported that he would lead troops from his commission to Fengxiang and recover Dasan Pass.

sentences.zh: 宗正寺奏：「準故事，諸陵有令、丞各一員，近例更委本縣令兼之。

translations.literal: The Court of the Imperial Clan memorialized: "Per precedent, each imperial tomb had one director and one vice-director; in recent practice the local county magistrate has been made to hold both posts concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of the Imperial Clan reported, "By established precedent each imperial tomb had one director and one vice-director, but recent practice had the local county magistrate hold both posts concurrently.

sentences.zh: 緣河南洛陽是京邑，兼令、丞不便。

translations.literal: Because Luoyang in Henan is the capital, concurrent service as director and vice-director is inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: Because Luoyang in Henan was the capital, having one man serve as both director and vice-director was impracticable.

sentences.zh: 」詔特置陵台令、丞各一員。

translations.literal: " An edict specially established one director and one vice-director for the Tomb Platform.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then specially established one director and one vice-director for the Tomb Platform.

sentences.zh: 己未，以前金吾大將軍李肅為左衛上將軍，充山陵修奉上下宮都部署。

translations.literal: On jiwei former Grand General of the Gold Crow Guard Li Su was made General of the Left Guard and appointed overall director of upper and lower palace tomb repair and maintenance.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Li Su, former Grand General of the Gold Crow Guard, was made General of the Left Guard and appointed overall director of repair and maintenance for the upper and lower palace tombs.

sentences.zh: 庚申，西面步軍都監王景從等自軍前至，奏：「今月十五日，大軍進攻鳳翔。

translations.literal: On gengshen Wang Jingcong, overall supervisor of western infantry, and others arrived from the front and memorialized: "On the fifteenth of this month the grand army advanced to attack Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Wang Jingcong, overall supervisor of the western infantry, and others arrived from the front and reported, "On the fifteenth of this month the main army advanced to attack Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 十六日，嚴衛右廂都指揮使尹暉引軍東面入城，右羽林都指揮使楊思權引軍西面入城，山南軍潰。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth, Yin Hui, commander of the right wing of the Honored Guard, led troops through the east into the city; Yang Siquan, commander of the Right Forest Guard, led troops through the west into the city; the Shannan army collapsed in rout.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth Yin Hui, commander of the right wing of the Honored Guard, led his troops in through the east gate, while Yang Siquan, commander of the Right Forest Guard, led his in through the west gate. The Shannan army broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 」帝聞之，謂康義誠等曰：「朕幼年嗣位，委政大臣，兄弟之間，必無榛梗。

translations.literal: " The Emperor heard this and said to Kang Yicheng and the others: "I succeeded to the throne in youth and entrusted governance to the great ministers; between brothers there should be no thorny obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor heard this, he said to Kang Yicheng and the others, "I came to the throne young and entrusted the government to my chief ministers. Between brothers there ought to be no estrangement.

sentences.zh: 諸公大計見告，朕獨難違，事至於此，何方轉禍？

translations.literal: If you lords would tell me your grand design, I alone would find it hard to refuse; matters have come to this—what means exist to turn calamity aside?
translations.idiomatic: If you would tell me your grand design, I alone would find it hard to refuse. Matters have come to this—what way remains to turn disaster aside?

sentences.zh: 朕當與左右自往鳳翔，迎兄主社稷；

translations.literal: I shall take my attendants and go personally to Fengxiang to welcome my elder brother to take charge of the realm;
translations.idiomatic: I shall take my attendants and go in person to Fengxiang to welcome my elder brother to take charge of the realm;

sentences.zh: 朕自歸藩，於理為便。

translations.literal: I myself shall return to my fief—in principle that is the convenient course.
translations.idiomatic: I myself shall return to my fief. By every reasonable measure that is the fitting course.

sentences.zh: 」朱宏昭、馮贇不對，義誠曰：「西師驚潰，蓋由主將失策。

translations.literal: " Zhu Hongzhao and Feng Yun made no reply. Yicheng said: "The western army's panic and rout were surely due to the commanding general's lost stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hongzhao and Feng Yun made no reply. Kang Yicheng said, "The western army's panic and collapse were surely the fault of the commanding general's bad strategy.

sentences.zh: 今駕下兵甲尚多，臣請自往關西，振其兵威，扼其衝要。

translations.literal: Now under the imperial carriage there are still many soldiers and weapons; your subject asks to go personally to the western passes, rouse their military might, and seize the critical points.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty still has many troops and arms at hand. I ask leave to go in person to the western passes, restore their fighting spirit, and hold the critical positions.

sentences.zh: 」義誠又累奏請行，帝召侍衛都將以下宣曰：「先皇帝棄萬國，朕於兄弟之中，無心爭立，一旦被召主喪，便委社稷，岐陽兄長，果致猜嫌。

translations.literal: " Yicheng repeatedly memorialized asking to go. The Emperor summoned the Guard commanders and those below and announced: "When the late Emperor abandoned the myriad lands, among my brothers I had no heart to contend for enthronement; once summoned to preside at the mourning, I entrusted the realm; my elder brother of Qiyang indeed came to suspicion and resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Yicheng repeatedly memorialized asking to take the field. The Emperor summoned the Guard commanders and those below and announced, "When the late Emperor left the myriad lands, I had no heart among my brothers to contend for the throne. Once summoned to preside at the mourning, I entrusted the realm to my charge. My elder brother at Qiyang indeed came to suspicion and resentment.

sentences.zh: 卿等頃從先朝千征萬戰，今日之事，寧不痛心！

translations.literal: You have just now followed the late court through a thousand campaigns and myriad battles—today's affair—can you not be pained at heart!
translations.idiomatic: You have just now followed the late court through a thousand campaigns and ten thousand battles. Can today's affair fail to pierce your hearts!

sentences.zh: 今據府庫，悉以頒賜，卿等勉之！

translations.literal: Now draw on the treasuries and grant everything in distribution—do your utmost!
translations.idiomatic: Now I shall draw on the treasuries and distribute everything among you. Do your utmost!

sentences.zh: 」乃出銀絹錢厚賜於諸軍。

translations.literal: " Silver, silk, and cash were then brought out and lavishly distributed to all armies.
translations.idiomatic: Silver, silk, and cash were then brought out and lavishly distributed to all the armies.

sentences.zh: 是時方事山陵，復有此賜，府藏為之一空，軍士猶負賞物揚言於路曰：「到鳳翔更請一分。

translations.literal: At this time tomb construction was underway; with this distribution added, the treasury was emptied; soldiers still shouldered their rewards and proclaimed in the roads: "When we reach Fengxiang we will ask for another share.
translations.idiomatic: Tomb construction was then underway, and with this distribution added the treasury was emptied. Soldiers still shouldered their rewards and shouted in the roads, "When we reach Fengxiang we will demand another share.

sentences.zh: 」其驕誕無畏如是。

translations.literal: " Such was their arrogance and reckless insolence.
translations.idiomatic: Such was their arrogance and reckless insolence.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，幸左藏庫，視給將士金帛。

translations.literal: On xinyou the Emperor visited the Left Treasury to oversee the distribution of gold and silk to officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the Emperor visited the Left Treasury to oversee the distribution of gold and silk to officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 是日，誅馬軍都指揮使朱洪實，坐與康義誠忿爭故也。

translations.literal: That day the cavalry commander Zhu Hongshi was executed for quarreling with Kang Yicheng.
translations.idiomatic: That day Zhu Hongshi, commander of the cavalry, was executed for quarreling with Kang Yicheng.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以康義誠為鳳翔行營都招討使，餘如故。

translations.literal: On guihai Kang Yicheng was made overall commissioner for the Fengxiang campaign headquarters; his other posts remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Kang Yicheng was made overall commissioner for the Fengxiang campaign headquarters; his other posts remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 以王思同為副招討使；

translations.literal: Wang Sitong was made deputy commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sitong was made deputy commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以安從進為順化軍節度使，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: An Congjin was made military commissioner of Shunhua and appointed commander of the Guard cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: An Congjin was made military commissioner of Shunhua and appointed commander of the Guard cavalry.

sentences.zh: 詔左右羽林軍四十指揮改為嚴衛，左右龍武、神武軍改為捧聖。

translations.literal: An edict changed the forty commands of the Left and Right Forest Guards to Honored Guard, and the Left and Right Dragon Martial and Divine Martial armies to Sacred Escort.
translations.idiomatic: An edict changed the forty commands of the Left and Right Forest Guards to Honored Guard, and the Left and Right Dragon Martial and Divine Martial armies to Sacred Escort.

sentences.zh: 甲子，陝州奏，潞王至潼關，害西面都部署王思同。

translations.literal: On jiazi Shaanzhou reported that the Prince of Lu had reached Tong Pass and killed Wang Sitong, overall western deployer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Shaanzhou reported that the Prince of Lu had reached Tong Pass and killed Wang Sitong, overall deployer of the western front.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宣諭西面行營將士，俟平鳳翔日，人賞二百千，府庫不足，以宮闈服玩增給。

translations.literal: On yihai the western campaign armies were publicly notified that when Fengxiang was pacified each man would receive two hundred strings in reward; if the treasuries were insufficient, palace women's garments and curios would supplement the grants.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the western campaign armies were publicly notified that when Fengxiang was pacified each man would receive two hundred strings in reward; if the treasuries proved insufficient, palace garments and curios would be added to make up the grants.

sentences.zh: 詔侍衛馬軍都指揮使安從進京城巡檢。

translations.literal: An edict ordered cavalry commander An Congjin to patrol the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered An Congjin, commander of the Guard cavalry, to patrol the capital.

sentences.zh: 是日，從進已得潞王書檄，潛布腹心矣。

translations.literal: That day Congjin had already received the Prince of Lu's letters and proclamations and secretly planted his confidants.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Congjin had already received the Prince of Lu's letters and proclamations and secretly planted his own confidants throughout the city.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，潞王至陝州。

translations.literal: On dingmao the Prince of Lu reached Shaanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Prince of Lu reached Shaanzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，帝急召孟漢瓊，不至；

translations.literal: On wuchen the Emperor urgently summoned Meng Hanqiong; he did not come;
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the Emperor urgently summoned Meng Hanqiong, but he did not come;

sentences.zh: 召朱宏昭，宏昭懼，投於井。

translations.literal: Zhu Hongzhao was summoned; Hongzhao, fearful, threw himself into a well.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hongzhao was summoned; in fear he threw himself into a well.

sentences.zh: 安從進尋殺馮贇於其第。

translations.literal: An Congjin soon killed Feng Yun at his residence.
translations.idiomatic: An Congjin soon killed Feng Yun at his residence.

sentences.zh: 是夜，帝以百騎出元武門，謂控鶴指揮使慕容遷曰：「爾誠有馬，控鶴從予。

translations.literal: That night the Emperor rode out through Xuanyuan Gate with a hundred horsemen and said to Crane-Control commander Murong Qian: "If you truly have horses, let the Crane-Control follow me.
translations.idiomatic: That night the Emperor rode out through Xuanyuan Gate with a hundred horsemen and said to Murong Qian, commander of the Crane-Control Guard, "If you truly have horses, let the Crane-Control follow me.

sentences.zh: 」及駕出，即闔門不行。

translations.literal: " When the imperial carriage departed, he immediately shut the gate and would not go.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage had gone out, Qian shut the gate at once and refused to follow.

sentences.zh: 遷乃帝素親信者也，臨危如是，人皆惡之。

translations.literal: Qian had been a man the Emperor long trusted; that at crisis he acted thus—all men hated him.
translations.idiomatic: Qian had long been one of the Emperor's trusted intimates; that he acted thus at the hour of crisis earned the hatred of all.

sentences.zh: 是月二十九日夜，帝至衛州東七八里，遇騎從自東來不避，左右叱之，乃曰：「鎮州節度使石敬瑭也。

translations.literal: On the night of the twenty-ninth of that month the Emperor reached seven or eight li east of Weizhou and encountered horsemen coming from the east who did not give way; attendants shouted at them, and they said: "It is Zhenzhou military commissioner Shi Jingtang.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the twenty-ninth of that month the Emperor reached a point seven or eight li east of Weizhou and met horsemen riding from the east who did not give way. When attendants shouted at them, they answered, "It is Shi Jingtang, military commissioner of Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 」帝喜，敬瑭拜舞於路，帝下馬慟哭，諭以「潞王危社稷，康義誠以下叛我，無以自庇，長公主見教，逆爾於路，謀社稷大計。

translations.literal: " The Emperor rejoiced. Jingtang bowed and danced in the road; the Emperor dismounted and wept bitterly, telling him: "The Prince of Lu endangers the realm; Kang Yicheng and those below have betrayed me—I have no means to protect myself; the Grand Princess gave counsel and sent me to meet you on the road to deliberate the great design for the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rejoiced. Jingtang bowed and danced in the road. The Emperor dismounted and wept bitterly, telling him, "The Prince of Lu endangers the realm. Kang Yicheng and those below have betrayed me, and I have no means to protect myself. The Grand Princess gave me counsel and sent me to meet you on the road to plan the great design for the realm.

sentences.zh: 」敬瑭曰：「衛州王宏贄宿舊諳事，且就宏贄圖之。

translations.literal: " Jingtang said: "Wang Hongzan of Weizhou is an old acquaintance versed in affairs; let us first go to Hongzan to devise a plan.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtang said, "Wang Hongzan of Weizhou is an old acquaintance who knows how affairs are managed. Let us first go to Hongzan and devise a plan.

sentences.zh: 」敬瑭即馳騎而前，見宏贄曰：「主上播遷，至此危迫，吾戚屬也，何以圖全？

translations.literal: " Jingtang immediately galloped ahead, saw Hongzan and said: "The sovereign is in flight and has come to this desperate pass; we are kinsmen—how can we devise a way to preserve him whole?
translations.idiomatic: Jingtang immediately galloped ahead, saw Hongzan, and said, "The sovereign is in flight and has come to this desperate pass. We are kinsmen—how can we find a way to preserve him?

sentences.zh: 」宏贄曰：「天子避狄，古亦有之，然於奔迫之中，亦有將相、國寶、法物，所以軍長瞻奉，不覺其亡也。

translations.literal: " Hongzan said: "That an emperor flees barbarian invasion has occurred in antiquity; yet even in flight there are usually generals and ministers, national treasures, and ritual regalia, so that military commanders may look up in reverence and not notice that the dynasty is lost.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzan said, "That an emperor flees barbarian invasion has happened before in antiquity, yet even in flight there are usually generals and ministers, national treasures, and ritual regalia, so that military commanders may look up in reverence and not realize that the dynasty is lost.

sentences.zh: 今宰職近臣從乎？

translations.literal: Are chief ministers and close attendants following now?
translations.idiomatic: Are chief ministers and close attendants following now?

sentences.zh: 寶玉、法物從乎？

translations.literal: Are jade treasures and ritual regalia following?
translations.idiomatic: Are jade treasures and ritual regalia following?

sentences.zh: 」詢之無有。

translations.literal: " Upon inquiry there were none.
translations.idiomatic: Upon inquiry there were none.

sentences.zh: 宏贄曰：「大樹將顛，非一繩所維。

translations.literal: Hongzan said: "When a great tree is about to topple, one rope cannot hold it up.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzan said, "When a great tree is about to topple, one rope cannot hold it up.

sentences.zh: 今以五十騎奔竄，無將相一人擁從，安能興復大計！

translations.literal: Now with fifty horsemen fleeing in disorder, without a single general or minister attending—how can one undertake a plan to restore the dynasty!
translations.idiomatic: Now with fifty horsemen fleeing in disorder and not a single general or minister in attendance, how can anyone undertake a plan to restore the dynasty!

sentences.zh: 所謂蛟龍失雲雨者也。

translations.literal: This is what is called a dragon deprived of clouds and rain.
translations.idiomatic: This is what people mean when they speak of a dragon deprived of clouds and rain.

sentences.zh: 今六軍將士總在潞邸矣，公縱以戚藩念舊，無奈之何！

translations.literal: Now the Six Armies' officers and soldiers are all at the Prince of Lu's residence; though you may by reason of kinship and old ties on the frontier wish otherwise, nothing can be done!
translations.idiomatic: Now the officers and soldiers of the Six Armies are all at the Prince of Lu's residence. Though you may, by reason of kinship and old frontier ties, wish otherwise, nothing can be done!

sentences.zh: 」遂與宏贄同謁於驛亭，宣坐謀之。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he and Hongzan together waited upon him at the post station and invited him to sit and deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he and Hongzan together waited upon the Emperor at the post station and invited him to sit and deliberate.

sentences.zh: 敬瑭以宏贄所陳以聞，弓箭庫使沙守榮、奔洪進前謂敬瑭曰：「主上即明宗愛子，公即明宗愛婿，富貴既同受，休戚合共之。

translations.literal: Jingtang reported what Hongzan had stated. Bow-and-arrow Store commissioners Sha Shourong and Ben Hongjin stepped forward and said to Jingtang: "The sovereign is Mingzong's beloved son; you are Mingzong's beloved son-in-law; you have shared fortune alike—glory and peril should be borne together.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtang reported what Hongzan had said. Sha Shourong and Ben Hongjin, commissioners of the Bow-and-Arrow Store, stepped forward and said to Jingtang, "The sovereign is Mingzong's beloved son, and you are Mingzong's beloved son-in-law. You have shared fortune alike—glory and peril ought to be borne together.

sentences.zh: 今謀於戚藩，欲期安復，翻索從臣、國寶，欲以此為辭，為賊算天子耶！

translations.literal: Now you plot with a frontier kinsman, hoping for safe restoration, yet turn about to demand attending ministers and national treasures—intending to use this as a pretext: are you calculating against the sovereign for the traitor's sake!
translations.idiomatic: Now you plot with a frontier kinsman, hoping for safe restoration, yet turn about to demand attending ministers and national treasures, intending to use this as a pretext—are you scheming against the sovereign on the traitor's behalf!

sentences.zh: 」乃抽佩刀刺敬瑭，敬瑭親將陳暉捍之，守榮與暉單戰而死，洪進亦自刎。

translations.literal: " They then drew their girdle daggers to stab Jingtang; Jingtang's personal guard Chen Hui parried them; Shourong and Hui fought one-on-one and died; Hongjin also cut his own throat.
translations.idiomatic: They then drew their girdle daggers to stab Jingtang. Chen Hui, Jingtang's personal guard, parried them. Shourong and Hui fought one-on-one and died, and Hongjin cut his own throat.

sentences.zh: 是日，敬瑭盡誅帝之從騎五十餘輩，獨留帝於驛，乃馳騎趨洛。

translations.literal: That day Jingtang had all fifty-odd of the Emperor's attending horsemen executed, kept the Emperor alone at the post station, and galloped toward Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: That day Jingtang had all fifty-odd of the Emperor's attending horsemen executed, left the Emperor alone at the post station, and galloped toward Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：閔帝爰自衝年，素有令問，及征從代邸，入踐堯階，屬軒皇之弓劍初遺，吳王之几杖未賜，遽生猜間，遂至奔亡。

translations.literal: The historiographer states: Emperor Min from infancy had a fine reputation; when summoned from the fief at Dai he ascended the throne of Yao; while the Yellow Emperor's bow and sword had only just been bequeathed and the King of Wu's armrest and staff had not yet been granted, suspicion suddenly arose and flight and ruin followed.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer writes: Emperor Min from infancy had enjoyed a fine reputation. When summoned from the fief at Dai he ascended the throne, yet while the Yellow Emperor's bow and sword had only just been bequeathed and the King of Wu's armrest and staff had not yet been granted, suspicion suddenly arose and flight and ruin followed.

sentences.zh: 蓋輔臣無安國之謀，非少主有不君之咎。

translations.literal: This was because the chief ministers lacked a plan to secure the realm; it was not that the young sovereign bore guilt for unkingly conduct.
translations.idiomatic: This was because the chief ministers lacked any plan to secure the realm; it was not that the young sovereign bore guilt for unkingly conduct.

sentences.zh: 以至越在草莽，失守宗祧，斯蓋天命之難忱，土德之將謝故也。

translations.literal: Thus he wandered in the wilds and lost hold of the ancestral temple—this was perhaps because Heaven's mandate was hard to rely upon and the Earth Virtue dynasty was about to decline.
translations.idiomatic: Thus he wandered in the wilds and lost hold of the ancestral temple—perhaps because Heaven's mandate was hard to rely upon and the dynasty of Earth Virtue was about to fade.
